title: Rundeck: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116586)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the Rundeck package affecting versions prior to 6.0.1-r11. The issue involves Go JOSE, which implements Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The vulnerability has a CVSS 4.0 base score of 6.9, indicating a medium severity level. A fix is available in version 6.0.1-r11.
